question: Does fresh FCMAE/ImageNet-22K-to-1K pretrained ConvNeXt-V2 Base with careful full fine-tuning improve inner-validation generalization over the stopped R201 package on the unchanged V2 fold00?
weights: official FCMAE pretrained, ImageNet-22K then ImageNet-1K fine-tuned 224px EMA weights
attention: none_added; native ConvNeXt-V2 Global Response Normalization retained
head: native global average pool; LayerNorm2d1024 eps1e-6; flatten; identity pre-logits; dropout0.2; linear1024-to7 logits
warmup_backbone_mode: eval; frozen parameters; native head train mode
preprocessing: PIL RGB; direct 224x224 bicubic resize preserving the entire image; ToTensor; ImageNet mean/std; no evaluation crop
augmentation: train only: independent horizontal/vertical flips0.5; uniform quarter-turn k in0,1,2,3; same resize and normalization
imbalance: train-only square-root inverse-frequency weights normalized to mean1; no oversampling or double compensation
sampler: natural training originals once per epoch; seeded random shuffle; no validation sampling changes
loss: weighted_cross_entropy_from_fp32_logits; numerator summed over effective batch divided by its target-weight sum
loss_weight_source: fold00 train counts only:265,416,890,93,902,5430,115 in frozen class order
no_decay_parameters: all biases; all one-dimensional normalization/GRN scale and offset parameters; enforce each trainable parameter appears exactly once

ema.update: after each accepted optimizer update from epoch3 onward; never after rejected update
ema.buffers: average floating parameters; copy all buffers from the current model; native ConvNeXt-V2 has no BatchNorm; preserve complete EMA state for recovery
ema.validation: separate identity-only FP32 pass on the same inner-validation cohort; no raw/EMA probability fusion
ema.placement: GPU during training and evaluation with FP32 parameters; CPU snapshots only when checkpointing; approximately0.327GiB additional VRAM

selection.accuracy: maximum raw-or-EMA inner-validation accuracy; earliest epoch; prefer raw when tied at the same epoch
selection.macro_f1: separate maximum raw-or-EMA macro-F1; earliest epoch; prefer raw when tied at the same epoch

stopping.meaningful_counters: based on per-epoch maximum raw-or-EMA accuracy and macro-F1, independently; observational only; do not terminate this fixed50-epoch run
stopping.manual_stop: finish and atomically commit the current epoch; close out with the explicit user stopping reason

history_metric_branches: val_* is raw branch; ema_val_* is separate EMA branch; never replace raw history with branch maxima
